name: Goldener Hirsch
beschreibung: The Goldener Hirsch is a hotel located in the heart of Reutte in Tyrol, Austria. The building reflects traditional Alpine architecture with a history that dates back several centuries. It provides accommodation with modern comforts integrated into a classic setting. Guests can dine at the on-site restaurant, which focuses on local cuisine. The hotel is situated near cultural attractions like the Museum im Grünen Haus and the Ehrenberg Castle ruins. Its central position allows for convenient exploration of the surrounding Lechtal region. The establishment includes facilities such as a sauna and parking for visitors. This makes it a practical base for both leisure and business travelers.
